verdict.rationale: E2B's core product is secure, isolated cloud sandboxes: agent code runs in a Firecracker microVM instead of the user's machine or server. Outbound network access can be switched off or limited with allow/deny lists, which keeps test runs away from production systems. This is real sandbox isolation, not a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and explicit documentation of separating sandbox data from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
With the E2B backend, the agent's built-in tools all execute inside an isolated sandbox instead of your machine
your agent's code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of your server
Control and restrict it with a simple on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists.
